label: Paired differences across seeds
subgoals: Run before and after builds with the same seeds
Subtract before from after for each seed

label: Seed-to-seed spread
subgoals: Subtract the mean from each difference
Sum the squared deviations and divide by n - 1
Take the square root to get the sample standard deviation

label: The paired t statistic
subgoals: Divide the standard deviation by the square root of n
Divide the mean difference by that standard error
Compare the absolute t with the critical value for n - 1 degrees of freedom
